name: CSCEC flexible on-site steel-structure welding robot
specialisedFor: on-site welding of steel column joints
summary: Welding robot shown by the Chinese contractor CSCEC at the 2026 World Robot Conference. It is designed for on-site butt welds on box columns and round tube columns and recommends welding parameters itself.

germany.statusNote: Shown by the contractor at a Beijing trade event; the news item talks of 'customers' for CSCEC's smart equipment but gives no model number, price or seller, and no German or EU sales route was found.

specs.label: Welding efficiency gain
specs.conditions: more than; maker claim, against its own baseline
specs.quote: increasing welding efficiency by more than 30 percent

specs.label: Joints
specs.value: butt welds on box columns and round tube columns
specs.quote: handles butt welds on components such as box columns and round tube columns

specs.label: Welding parameters
specs.value: automatic recommendation of optimal welding parameters
specs.quote: It automatically recommends optimal welding parameters

notes: The news item gives no hardware description (carrier, rail or crawler, arm count); legs, wheels and tracks are left false and arms 1 with a welding torch is the minimum implied by 'welding robot'.

CSCEC separately shows a compact collaborative welding robot (start and end points set by the worker, used in steel structures, shipbuilding and nuclear piping); it is not recorded here because it is not described as site-mobile.

evidence.task: Welds butt joints of box columns and round tube columns on site in steel-structure construction
evidence.note: Exhibited by CSCEC; no building project is named.

sources.title: CSCEC showcases smart products at 2026 World Robot Conference

Whether it is sold to other firms or only used by CSCEC is not stated; lifecycle 'prototype' is the closest value.
